fundamental_blocker.name: same-geometry-same-content source-coordinate discriminability
fundamental_blocker.reason: For materialized request clones, request storage is intentionally disjoint from source storage. If two persistent coordinates have identical content and geometry, content/descriptor plus storage separation cannot establish which source coordinate was cloned. A challenge that modifies source/request values changes scientific state; consuming builder provenance restores the producer TCB the verifier is intended to reduce.
